overview.description: The Investment House ETF (TIH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund provides exposure to the broad US equity market, targeting companies with high long-term growth potential and reasonable valuations. It is an actively managed fund aiming for long term capital appreciation. TIH was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by TIH Funds.

holdings.infoBox: TIH is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Alphabet stock at 6.94%, Apple at 4.87%, Dell Technologies at 4.84%, NVIDIA at 4.70%, and Microsoft at 4.60%.
